# Alchemy Academy

> Online interior design school by Casa Alchemy for homeowners who want to design their own home the professional way. It is not a course for people training to become interior designers.

Alchemy Academy teaches the design decisions professionals make instinctively, structured so homeowners can apply them to their own spaces: colour, layout, lighting, furniture, materials and styling, room by room. Learning is self paced through video lessons, Master Guides, quizzes and completion certificates, plus live sessions with experts and a members community called The A Tribe.

The Academy is run by Casa Alchemy Studio & Academy Pty Ltd, a residential interior design studio based in Sydney, Australia.

## Founder

Lorena Couto is a Sydney based interior designer with more than 20 years of experience and a background in Architecture, Urbanism and Design Thinking. Casa Alchemy has transformed more than 100 homes across Australia, New Zealand, the USA, Dubai, Germany, Portugal and Brazil, and has won 5 industry awards.

## Courses

Each course covers one area of the home. Published courses include The Path to a Colourful Life, The Sacred Bedroom, The Elemental Bathroom and Dominating Compositions, with more rooms (kitchen, living room, dining room, workspace and outdoors) coming.

## Membership and pricing

All prices are in US dollars.

- Annual Member: USD 59 per month, billed yearly at USD 708. Every course, live expert masterclasses, the community forum, the suppliers directory, private events and exclusive deals.
- Monthly Member: USD 99 per month, cancel anytime. Every course, live expert masterclasses, the community forum and the suppliers directory.
- Individual course: from USD 159, a one time payment for 6 months of access to one course.
- A 7 day cooling off period applies to memberships.
